ABOUT_WHO_BODY: Kollegianeren is made by Toke, who lived at Egmont himself. He looks after it in his spare time and makes no money from it: no ads, no selling of data, no subscription.
ABOUT_OPEN_BODY:
All the code is public on GitHub, including the rules for who may read and write what in the database. Anyone can see exactly what the app does, and every change is in the history. The code is under the MIT license: anyone may use, change and share it.

Want to fix a bug or build something new? Make a pull request on GitHub. Toke looks at it, tries it on the test version and puts it out.
ABOUT_DATA_BODY:
In Google's Firebase: a database (Firestore) and logins (Firebase Authentication), in Google's data centres in the USA. Pictures of products and residents are at Cloudinary.

Every night a copy of the kitchens, residents, products and the last year's purchases goes to a server at Toke's home. The copies are kept for a year.
ABOUT_SEES_BODY:
A kitchen sees only its own purchases, residents and accounts. Other kitchens see only what you put on Kollegiet yourselves. In the app, Toke sees only numbers per kitchen, never residents' names or purchases. Secret votes are counted by a program, not a person.

To be honest: as owner of the Firebase project and of the copies, Toke can technically see everything. He does not look, but the code cannot prove that, so it is written here.
ABOUT_COST_BODY:
0 kr. The app runs on Firebase's free plan, which gives 50,000 reads and 20,000 writes in the database a day. The app is built to stay well below: each tablet fetches only the newest, and the nightly copies have their own ceiling.

If the limit is ever reached, the database pauses until the next day (9 in the morning, Danish time). It never turns into a bill: there is no payment card on it.
ABOUT_MAINTAIN_BODY:
Everything new is tried first on a test version with copies of the data, and only then on the real one. New versions reach the tablets by themselves.

Bugs and wishes: write to Toke here on Aktuelt. Bigger ideas go up under Proposals, so every kitchen can say what it thinks before they are built.
ABOUT_STOP_BODY:
The app keeps running by itself on the free plan; nothing expires. Everything about how it is run is in the code on GitHub, so someone else can take over, and Toke can give a new caretaker access to the project.

The code is open, so you can always take a copy and run your own. And you can always download your kitchen's data yourselves under Access.
ABOUT_HACKED_TITLE: If someone tries to break in
ABOUT_HACKED_BODY:
Passwords are handled by Google, not by the app. The database's rules say that a login can only read and write its own kitchen, and the rules are tested automatically on every change.

A stolen tablet can only buy for its own kitchen, and its login can be removed under Access. If something goes wrong anyway, the data can be put back from the night's copy.
ABOUT_FUTURE_BODY: Under Proposals is what Toke is thinking of building, and what has been done. Give a 👍 to what you want, and say what you think.

REVEAL_TITLE: Something has awakened in the machine
REVEAL_P1: For almost ten years Kollegianeren has quietly kept track of your beer tab. Some of you have probably wondered who is actually behind it.
REVEAL_P2: I am. My name is Toke, I used to live here, and I have been haunting your kitchen tablet ever since. I just gave the whole thing a proper overhaul: it looks almost the same, but everything under the hood is new, safer and faster.
REVEAL_P3: Under News you can follow what is going on, and write to me directly if something bugs you or you have a good idea.
OFFLINE_BANNER: No connection. Purchases are saved on the tablet and sent when the network is back.
REGISTER_INVITE_HINT: Kollegianeren needs an invitation. Get a link or code from your kitchen's treasurer, from another kitchen, or write to Toke.
REGISTER_INVITE_USED: That code has already been used.
REGISTER_GRANT_NEW: This invitation gives you a brand new kitchen of your own.
ACCESS_LOGINS_HINT: Several people can log in to the same kitchen. Give a tablet login to the kitchen's tablet and a treasurer login to whoever runs products and accounting.
ACCESS_ROLES_EXPLAINED: Tablet can only buy and undo the latest purchase. Treasurer can also manage products, residents, accounting and invitations. The owner can also remove logins.
ACCESS_NEW_KITCHEN_HINT: Know a kitchen without a beer system? Send them an invitation and they can set up their own.
ACCESS_COPIED: Invitation link copied. Send it to the recipient.
HANDOVER_HINT: Moving out? Pass the kitchen's owner login on to whoever takes over. We send a link to the new email, and once it is opened the kitchen is logged into with that email instead of yours. Products, residents, accounting and Kollegiet all stay. The new owner picks their own password with "Forgot password".
HANDOVER_CONFIRM_HINT: Once the link is opened, you can no longer log in with your email. Tablets and phones using this login have to log in again with the new email.
HANDOVER_NEXT: Ask them to open it (check spam too), then pick a new password with "Forgot password" on the login page. Nothing changes until the link is opened.
HANDOVER_BAD_EMAIL: That email does not look right.
HANDOVER_EMAIL_TAKEN: That email already has a login. The new owner needs another email, or can write to Toke.
HANDOVER_TOO_MANY: Too many attempts. Try again in a bit.
RESIDENTS_MOVE_OUT_CONFIRM: Remember to settle up. The resident leaves the beer system, but their purchases stay in the accounts.
RESIDENTS_DELETE_CONFIRM: The resident is deleted completely. Prefer "Move out" so the accounts still add up.
RESIDENTS_ANONYMISE_CONFIRM: Name, room and photo are removed, also on the purchases. Amounts and dates stay. This cannot be undone.
RESIDENTS_DUE: moved-out residents have been gone for more than
PRODUCTS_STOCK_START: How many do you have in stock now?
RESIDENTS_LINK_COPIED: Private link copied. Send it only to
ME_PRIVATE: This is your private link to your beer tab. Do not share it. The treasurer can make a new one if it got out.
ME_NOT_FOUND: The link is wrong or has been replaced. Ask your treasurer for a new one.
PRODUCTS_RECEIVE_HINT: How many units came in. A minus corrects the stock down.
PRODUCTS_DELETE_CONFIRM: The product is deleted. Old purchases keep its name. Prefer "Active" to hide it.
ACCESS_REMOVE_HINT: The login can no longer see the kitchen. You can invite again later.

FOOD_EXPENSES_NONE: No expenses yet. Add them when you shop, days before is fine.
FOOD_EXPENSES_SPLIT_LATER: The bill is split once the dinner is eaten and the sign-up closed.

FOOD_COOK_EDITS: Sign-up is closed. Only the cook edits the list now.
FOOD_DELETE_CONFIRM: The food club and its sign-ups are deleted.

ADMIN_READS_HINT_GRID: Documents read from Firestore, by page and collection. Opened: a list opened fresh. Reopened: the same list again within 30 minutes, which only costs what changed. Woken: every open list again, after the tablet slept or was offline for more than 30 minutes. Live: changes while the list is open. Fetched: one-off lookups.
ADMIN_USAGE_HINT: How many times each page was opened or each action used. The darker the cell, the more the kitchen uses it compared with the others.
ADMIN_USAGE_NONE: No numbers yet. The app counts from the next release, and the numbers come with the next nightly run.
ADMIN_NO_NAMES: Numbers per kitchen only, no residents' names
ADMIN_NIGHTLY_STALE: More than two days old. Is tokeserver down? Regnskab and Statistik read more purchases until it runs again.
ADMIN_IN_USE: Kitchens in use (bought in the last 7 days)
ADMIN_PURCHASES_7: Purchases in the last 7 days (against the week before)
ADMIN_MEALS_30: Food clubs in the last 30 days
ADMIN_ERROR: The numbers could not be loaded.

KOL_ACH_HOW_drinks100: Sell 100 drinks in one drinks battle.
KOL_ACH_HOW_beer50: Sell 50 beers in one beer battle.
KOL_ACH_HOW_beer100: Sell 100 beers in one beer battle.
KOL_ACH_HOW_diners50: Get 50 diners at the food club in one food club battle.
KOL_ACH_HOW_gym25: Tap +1 for 25 gym visits in one gym battle.
KOL_ACH_HOW_firstWin: Win your first battle against at least one other kitchen.
KOL_ACH_HOW_dinners10: Hold 10 food club dinners in the food club.
KOL_ACH_HOW_dinners50: Hold 50 food club dinners in the food club.
KOL_ACH_HOW_dinners100: Hold 100 food club dinners in the food club.
KOL_ACH_HOW_plantMonth: Hold at least four food club dinners in a month, at least half of them vegetarian or vegan.
